key_actions.summary: Climbs Mont Ventoux with his brother Gherardo (26 April), an event he later treats in De vita solitaria as a turn toward inner-directed contemplation.
Crowned poet laureate on the Capitoline Hill at Rome (8 April), the first such laureation since antiquity — a deliberate revival of classical practice.
Discovers Cicero's letters to Atticus at the Verona Chapter Library; the find decisively shapes the humanist epistolary mode he subsequently develops.
